evidence: deepseek: "if p1 + p2 > T" followed by "if sum1 > T"; gpt-oss: "sum1 += p1", "sum2 += p2", and "p1 + p2 > T"; qwen and glm use the same routing and total-load tests
affordance_in_statement: "even if it were granted exclusive use of the plant and experienced zero wait time, would still complete after time T" and "even if it never sat idle and processed all its assigned tasks back-to-back starting from time 0, would still be operating after time T"
removal_suggestion: Add a mandatory one-unit transfer or handoff delay between station 1 and station 2, and state that routing-delay certificates must account for it. This preserves the existing input, output, bounds, and examples, but makes the routing lower bound p1 + 1 + p2 rather than p1 + p2.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Checks each independent job duration p1 + p2 against T, then checks total station loads.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "exclusive use of the plant" with "zero wait time" and stations operating "back-to-back"

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Accumulates sum1 and sum2 and selects the first job whose p1 + p2 exceeds T.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "would still complete after time T" and "would still be operating after time T"

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses the same per-job p1 + p2 test before comparing total station workloads.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "granted exclusive use of the plant" and "never sat idle"

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Records a job with p1 + p2 > T, otherwise outputs a station whose processing-time sum exceeds T.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "zero wait time" and "processed all its assigned tasks back-to-back starting from time 0"

common_affordance: The statement directly defines both certificate types as independent additive lower bounds: p1 + p2 for one job and the sum of all p1 or all p2 values for a station.
recommended_edit: Specify that every job incurs a mandatory one-time-unit transfer delay after station 1 and before station 2, and require the Routing Delay test to include that delay. For example, a job with p1 + p2 = T would now be a routing-delay certificate, while all existing examples retain their outputs.
